meta.title: Changelog — plot
meta.description: What is new, improved, and fixed in plot. Dated release notes for the movie and TV companion.

pageMeta: What shipped in plot, newest first.
intro: Every public ship lands here the same day, in plain language. Entries use New, Improved, and Fixed.

new: Pick for Me is now Just Decide, and everyone gets one free pick a day
Choose the poster, backdrop and logo you want on any title
Home is built around your own titles: pin shelves, set their order, pick a card style and density, and rate what you have just watched in one loop
A Watch together card on Home, and Watch together is on for everyone in the iOS app with a redesigned start page
Episode ratings on title pages, regional age ratings, time left on a show and when it ends, and specials in the episode guide
Imports run in the background: pick a source, queue a few, and start them during onboarding. Your sources now live in Settings
A prompt for episode alerts and streaming arrival when you save a show or film
improved: Onboarding holds steady: your profile saves reliably and setup picks up where it left off if something interrupts it
Title pages on the website load faster
fixed: Link previews for profiles and lists recover on their own after a temporary outage instead of staying blank
Photo share cards show up in WhatsApp
The web app recovers when a browser extension changes the page
Imports recover from odd export files, and the import dialogs in onboarding are clearer

new: Sign in with Apple on web and in the iOS app
Just Decide, a tonight picker for Premium: answer a few questions, get a pick, and keep the searches you like
Watch together: see what is on both your watchlists, swipe through picks with a friend, and build shared lists. Premium hosts, friends join free
Smart lists that keep themselves up to date from rules you set, and collaborative lists you build with friends
Follow actors and directors, a Your people shelf on Home, and an alert when someone you follow has new work. Continue watching shows what has an episode waiting
Alerts for your watchlist: when a film arrives on one of your services or becomes free to watch, when a film on your list comes out, and when a show you follow has a new episode, with Add to calendar
Taste overlap: compare your ratings with someone you follow
Share cards from your profile and History: Highlights, Streak, Top 5, Activity, You vs the crowd, Genres and Your person, in a choice of themes
Import your history from Plex, Trakt, IMDb ratings, TV Time archives and Simkl
A live calendar subscription and theme families for Premium, plus a one-time calendar export for everyone
Choose who can see your Want to Watch, and set visibility per list
New onboarding on web and iOS, with a Finishing touches card on your first visit home
A Lists from plot shelf of curated lists you can save, and Plot’s Picks that rotate on their own
Horror, Romance and Thriller for shows, watch status chips on list titles, and a status filter with a progress bar
In the iOS app: search titles, people and friends together, search across My Lists, export your data, change your profile photo, and a feedback section in the drawer
A support page on the website
improved: Undo after removing a title, changing episode progress, or creating a list
Quick one-line prompts to mark a title watched after you save it, and to rate it after you mark it watched
One persistent foot bar on the title panel, on web and iOS
The sidebar account menu holds your theme, Help build Plot and account links. History and Guide sit in the same place on iOS as on web
History is cached between pages so moving around the app feels quicker
The website has a new footer, uppercase navigation, and a homepage that says what plot is for: review, rate, remember
fixed: Five-star ratings save, and your rating and review stay when you watch a title again
Searching a list no longer loses focus after one character, and custom lists can be filtered and searched on a phone
Signing up is more reliable when a password is autofilled or the human check is slow
Taps reach the hero and binge cards on phones
Release notes say In theaters and write dates in US order, and home releases are no longer labelled as in cinemas
Deleting your account copes with a dropped connection, and the newsletter Unsubscribe link opens a real page

new: A public changelog at theplot.tv/changelog, so you can see what shipped without digging store notes
A collapsible navigation rail on web that gives the page you are on more room
A redesigned New Releases page with clearer browsing and filters
A refreshed notifications layout that is easier to scan
improved: Mobile navigation and sheets feel tighter and more consistent across the app
List controls and recovery when something goes wrong mid-edit
More film and TV title pages for search and sharing
Saving an article from What's On hands off more cleanly into the app
fixed: Poster quick actions on lists working again
Genre filtering on New Releases completing as expected
Favorites shelf staying compact on profiles
Navigation rail and title panel polish that left controls misaligned
